title: Authority intake and clean stacked branch gate

objective.statement: Re-read remote main, PR #20, worktree cleanliness, toolchain, package binding, and Atlassian identifiers before any source mutation.
objective.observable_success: A machine intake receipt proves exact identities or stops before mutation.
non_goals: Changing scientific tolerances or expected outputs

P0_failure_modes.trigger: Remote main or PR #20 head/tree differs from the package.

required_detection.test: Preserve paths and STOP; never reset or stash without explicit ownership.

P1_failure_modes.trigger: PM-7 or Confluence page binding differs.

forbidden_changes: Do not change reference tolerances or expected scientific outputs to make tests pass.
Do not guess across a scientific or numerical specification boundary.
Do not suppress failed stages, cells, tests, or Atlassian drift.

preconditions.command: git fetch --prune origin main research/a1-post-a2a3-kernel-rerun docs/k0-codex-execution-package-20260827

invariants.statement: No source mutation occurs before exact authority and dirty-worktree inspection.

failure_modes.trigger: Remote main or PR #20 head/tree differs from the package.

ordered_steps.action: Record exact Git refs, branch, tree, dirty state, Rust/Cargo versions, control PR, Jira, and Confluence IDs.

must_preserve: no branch creation or switching inside Codex
